title: Lingaa
desc: Lingaa, a petty thief, turns over a new leaf after realising the role his grandfather has played in building a dam for the villagers. He then dedicates his life to saving it from a corrupt minister.

title: Khiladi 786
desc: A father who runs a matrimonial agency believes that his son is a failure in life. To prove him wrong, the son takes on the task of finding a match for a gangster's sister.

title: Real Tevar
desc: Harsha is the idealistic scion of a self-made multimillionaire, Ravikanth. After a chance meeting with Charuseela leads him to a remote village, Harsha wishes to develop it with her help.

title: Ab Tumhare Hawale Watan Saathiyo
desc: Kunal falls in love with Shweta and decides to stay in the army to get close to her but soon finds out that she is waiting for her husband Rajeev to return from war.

title: Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri
desc: Two individuals discover their identities and develop affection, yet domestic obligations strain their bond. Consequently, they part ways while anticipating an eventual reunion.

title: Antim: The Final Truth
desc: Rahul runs away from his poverty-stricken village life to become a gangster in the city. There, he locks horns with an upstanding policeman who tries to set him on the right path.

title: Don 2
desc: Trouble awaits Don as the European drug cartel bosses plan his downfall. However, new allies and former foes promise to aid him in the challenging times.

title: F.A.L.T.U
desc: Four desperate friends, who secure poor grades in their examinations, concoct a fake university when they fail to secure college admissions and face dismal futures.

title: Kyaa Kool Hain Hum 3
desc: Kanhaiya, an adult film actor, asks his fellow actors to pose as his fake traditional family to impress his girlfriend Shalu's conservative father.

title: Mahaveer No.1
desc: A young orphan, White, challenges the sly Adikesavalu for control of the Ongole market and his daughter. Their fight unearths a past of greed, injustice and a simmering quest for revenge.

title: Gangubai Kathiawadi
desc: A woman is forced to abandon her Bollywood dreams after her boyfriend sells her to a brothel. As time passes, she builds strong connections in the criminal underworld and rises to power.

title: Haq
desc: Shazia Bano turns to the court for justice when her husband, Abbas, abandons her and their young children after marrying another woman.

title: Sanam Teri Kasam
desc: A librarian, cast out by her family, asks her neighbour to help her find a suitable husband. However, their growing feelings for each other complicate the situation.

title: Raid 2
desc: An honest Income Tax officer, Amay Patnaik, confronts the corrupt nexus in Bhoj. Beneath the veneer of honesty lies a sinister operation tied to Dada Bhai, a revered politician.

title: Gumnaam
desc: An astute sub-inspector relentlessly pursues a malicious serial killer who victimises vulnerable adolescent girls. Therefore, this probe incurs severe consequences.
